name: Longitudinal Verdict Refresh
description: Treat a settled research verdict as PERISHABLE: watch its load-bearing sources on a cadence and re-open the verdict only when a source actually moves materially. The distinguishing machine is the pair (change-detection loop, temporal-validity memory write): a material change spawns a fresh research run as a SUBWORKFLOW and marks the old note superseded_by, while a non-change writes a dated no-op observation - because silence is not evidence a page is stable. A monitor that has never fired is validated against a known-changed control page before its silence is trusted, and if the monitor service is unreachable the verdict is marked STALE-UNWATCHED, not HOLDS.

verdict_note_permalink.description: The memory note holding the verdict under watch

control_url.description: A page the owner can edit at will - the detector control that proves the monitor can fire

materiality_rule.description: The stated rule that decides whether a diff is material; recorded with every decision because the judgement is not deterministic

max_cycles.description: Hard bound on the polling loop

etag_precheck.description: Cheap HTTP ETag / Last-Modified check before spending a paid monitor call

monitor-registrar.description: Registers the monitors on a PAID external service; the owner must approve because it commits standing quota

change-poller.description: Polls on cadence and does the cheap ETag pre-check first; reports a service outage as an outage, never as no-change

materiality-judge.description: Runs ONLY on a detected change and decides materiality against the stated rule, recording the rule text with the decision

memory-curator.description: Writes temporal validity: superseded_by on the old note, valid_as_of on the new one, so recall surfaces current truth

routes.reason: materiality is the only judgement in the loop; the polling around it is mechanical

stages.title: Register monitors on the verdict's load-bearing URLs (paid, owner-approved)

work_unit.title: Register one monitor per watched URL plus one on the owner-editable control page
work_unit.question_or_target: Register a change monitor for each load-bearing URL and one for the control page. Record the monitor ids and the quota this commits, because standing monitor quota is the real cost of this blueprint.

assigned_model_vendor_role.basis: substantive subagents default to Opus (performance rule: quality over cost)

work_unit.evidence_requirement: each row carries the monitor id returned by the service, the URL, the cadence, and the quota committed
tests_required: registering with an unreachable service must FAIL loudly, never record a monitor id it did not receive
work_unit.reviewer_requirement: the owner approves the standing quota commitment before this stage runs (tool_policy.require_owner_approval)
work_unit.completion_sentinel: SUCCESS:BPR-0601 emitted only when every watched URL plus the control page has a monitor id returned by the service; otherwise FAILED:BPR-0601 <failure-class> <reason>
work_unit.retry_policy: fixed backoff, at most 2 attempts; a second failure leaves the verdict UNWATCHED and says so

stages.title: Detector control: edit the control page and require the monitor to fire

work_unit.title: Prove the monitor can fire at all before trusting any silence from it
work_unit.question_or_target: Have the owner-editable control page changed, then check its monitor. It MUST fire. A monitor that does not fire on a known change measures nothing, and every silent monitor in this run is therefore untrustworthy.

assigned_model_vendor_role.basis: substantive subagents default to Opus (performance rule: quality over cost)

work_unit.evidence_requirement: the control page's before/after hash, the monitor's fire event, and the elapsed time from edit to detection
tests_required: MANDATORY both-states: the control monitor must FIRE after the page is edited and must NOT fire on an unedited static page in the same cycle
work_unit.reviewer_requirement: the control gate blocks the loop until this fires, so no silent monitor is ever read as stability
work_unit.completion_sentinel: SUCCESS:BPR-0602 emitted only when the control monitor fired and the fire event is recorded with its detection latency; otherwise FAILED:BPR-0602 <failure-class> <reason>
work_unit.retry_policy: fixed backoff, at most 3 attempts spread over the cadence; a third miss fails the control

stages.title: Silence is not evidence: the loop cannot start until the control fires
Poll on cadence; judge materiality only on a real change

body.title: Cheap ETag / Last-Modified check before spending a paid call

work_unit.title: Compare ETag and Last-Modified before invoking the paid monitor
work_unit.question_or_target: For each watched URL compare the stored ETag / Last-Modified with the live headers. Only URLs whose headers moved, or that expose no validators at all, are escalated to the paid monitor call.

assigned_model_vendor_role.basis: substantive subagents default to Opus (performance rule: quality over cost)

work_unit.evidence_requirement: per URL: the stored and live validator values, and the escalate / skip decision
tests_required: a URL exposing NO ETag and NO Last-Modified must be escalated, never treated as unchanged
work_unit.reviewer_requirement: the poll stage re-reads this decision and records any URL it skipped so a missed change is attributable
work_unit.completion_sentinel: SUCCESS:BPR-0603 emitted only when every watched URL has an escalate / skip decision carrying both validator values; otherwise FAILED:BPR-0603 <failure-class> <reason>
work_unit.retry_policy: fixed backoff, at most 2 attempts per URL

body.title: Check the monitors and record a dated observation either way

work_unit.title: Check each escalated monitor and write a dated observation, change or no-change
work_unit.question_or_target: Check the monitors for the escalated URLs. Write a dated observation for EVERY watched URL - including an explicit no-op record - so an absence of fires is attributable rather than silent. A service outage is recorded as STALE-UNWATCHED, never as no-change.

assigned_model_vendor_role.basis: substantive subagents default to Opus (performance rule: quality over cost)

work_unit.evidence_requirement: one dated row per watched URL per cycle: changed / unchanged / STALE-UNWATCHED, with the diff summary when changed
tests_required: with the service unreachable, every row must read STALE-UNWATCHED - a run that reports 'unchanged' during an outage is the failure this test exists for
work_unit.reviewer_requirement: the memory curator refuses to write HOLDS for any cycle containing a STALE-UNWATCHED row
work_unit.completion_sentinel: SUCCESS:BPR-0604 emitted only when every watched URL has a dated observation for this cycle; otherwise FAILED:BPR-0604 <failure-class> <reason>
work_unit.retry_policy: fixed backoff, at most 2 attempts; a second failure records STALE-UNWATCHED

body.title: Judge materiality against the stated rule, on change only

work_unit.title: Decide whether a detected diff is material to THIS verdict
work_unit.question_or_target: For each detected change decide material / immaterial strictly against the stated materiality_rule, and record the rule text verbatim beside the decision, because the judgement is not deterministic and must be auditable later.

assigned_model_vendor_role.basis: substantive subagents default to Opus (performance rule: quality over cost)

work_unit.evidence_requirement: each decision quotes the diff span it turned on and the materiality_rule text as applied
tests_required: a cosmetic diff (whitespace, a nav link) must be immaterial
both-states: a diff that changes the number the verdict rests on must be material
work_unit.reviewer_requirement: the owner can re-read the rule text and the diff span together, so a drifting interpretation is visible
work_unit.completion_sentinel: SUCCESS:BPR-0605 emitted only when every detected change has a material / immaterial decision carrying the diff span and the rule text; otherwise FAILED:BPR-0605 <failure-class> <reason>

stages.title: On a material change, re-open the verdict by spawning a fresh research run
An unreachable monitor service means STALE-UNWATCHED, not HOLDS
Write temporal validity: superseded_by on the old note, valid_as_of on the new

work_unit.title: Update the memory graph so recall surfaces current truth and dead ends are retired
work_unit.question_or_target: Write the verdict status. On a material change: add superseded_by to the old note and valid_as_of to the new one. On no change: append a dated no-op observation. On an outage: mark the verdict STALE-UNWATCHED.

assigned_model_vendor_role.basis: substantive subagents default to Opus (performance rule: quality over cost)

work_unit.evidence_requirement: the supersession graph records both edges (old superseded_by new, new valid_as_of date) and the note revision ids returned by the memory store
tests_required: exactly one superseded_by edge per material change - a second write for the same change is a duplicate defect
an outage cycle must produce a STALE-UNWATCHED status and NO supersession edge
work_unit.reviewer_requirement: one independent reviewer re-reads the old note and confirms it now points forward, so recall cannot surface the retired verdict as current
work_unit.completion_sentinel: SUCCESS:BPR-0606 emitted only when the verdict status is written, and every material change has exactly one supersession edge carrying store revision ids; otherwise FAILED:BPR-0606 <failure-class> <reason>
work_unit.retry_policy: two strikes then pivot: after two failed writes, leave the old note untouched and escalate - a half-written supersession is worse than none

impact.blast_radius: registers PAID standing monitors and mutates the memory graph; deleting the monitors is an owner action

contraindications: NOT for high-churn pages - monitor noise swamps signal, and the stopping rule exists to say so
NOT a substitute for re-running the research when the domain shifts structurally: a structural shift can invalidate a verdict with ZERO URL changes, which this blueprint cannot see
unverified: UNVERIFIED end-to-end; settling experiment = register 3 monitors, edit exactly one control page, and confirm exactly one fire and exactly one superseded_by write.
UNVERIFIED that <=5 watched verdicts is the sustainable ceiling before monitor noise dominates; the monitor-noise-dominates stopping rule is the instrument that would measure it.
x_extensions.owner_decision: Which verdicts (if any) are worth a standing PAID monitor, and at what cadence?

worked_example.name: watch a model-pricing verdict weekly

params.materiality_rule: a change is material only if a price-per-million-tokens figure or a model id in the verdict's table changes

acceptance: the control page edit produces exactly one monitor fire
a cosmetic diff on a watched page is judged immaterial and writes a dated no-op
a price change is material, spawns the research subworkflow, and writes exactly one superseded_by edge

stopping_rule_controls.why: the floor stops a single noisy first cycle from retiring the monitor
the loop must end when the owner retires or unsubscribes the verdict
